A [[human]]<ref name="Human" /> served as a '''stormtrooper''' in the [[First Order]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="The Disappeared /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="34 ABY">{{ResistanceDate|1|18}}</ref> they accompanied another [[Unidentified First Order stormtrooper (First Order: Enlist Now)|trooper]] and a [[BB-series astromech droid]] to place a [[hologram]] of the recruitment [[Painting|poster]] [[First Order: Enlist Now]] in [[Aunt Z's Tavern]]. The trio later returned to the [[Cantina|tavern]] after recieving reports of a disturbance.<ref name="The Disappeared" />
